Attachments Application Format Preview Detailed Advertisement Preview Back to Job List Attachment Preview Loading preview…
 
 
     INDIAN STATISTICAL INSTITUTE 
    203, B.T. ROAD, KOLKATA–700108 
    (An Autonomous Institute funded by MoS&PI, Government of India) 
____________________________________________________________________________________ 
Advertisement No. REC-10/2026-7, KOL                                                                                           Date: 28/10/2026 
The Institute invites application s from the Indian Nationals for the positions of part -time contractual specialist doctors in the 
following Disciplines/Specializations in its Headquarters, Kolkata  initially for One (01) year duration, likely to be extended 
further based on requirement and performance. 
 
Area of Specialization No. of  Positions 
Ophthalmology (Eye) One 
Otorhinolaryngology (ENT) One 
Psychiatry One 
Psychological Counsellor One 
 
 
Area of Specialization Part Time Contractual Specialist Doctor: 
(Ophthalmologist) 
Consolidated Pay Rs 30000/- per Month 
Working hours To attend OPD for 02 Days per week  on fixed dates and time.  (Each OPD 
session will be of 3 hours  duration ) Change of dates will be allowed only if 
there is a Institute holiday on the dates fixed. 
Essential Qualifications & 
Experience 
Candidates having MBBS, MS/DO/DNB in Ophthalmology shall  
be considered. Experience: At least 3 years for MS/DNB. At least  
5 years for DO.  
 
Area of Specialization 
Part Time Contractual Specialist Doctor: 
(Otorhinolaryngologist - ENT) 
Consolidated Pay Rs 30000/- per Month 
Working hours To attend OPD for 02 Days per week  on fixed dates and time.  (Each OPD 
session will be of 3 hours duration  ) Change of dates will be allowed only if 
there is a Institute holiday on the dates fixed. 
Essential Qualifications & Experience Candidates having MBBS, MS/DLO/DNB in ENT shall be considered. 
Experience: At least 3 years for MS/DNB. At least 5 years  
for DLO. 
 
Area of Specialization 
Part Time Contractual Specialist Doctor: 
(Psychiatrist) 
Consolidated Pay Rs 30000/- per Month and Rs.2500 per session for Sensitization Programme 
Working hours To attend OPD for 02 Days per week  on fixed dates and time.  (Each OPD 
session will be of 3 hours duration  ) Change of dates will be allowed only if 
there is a Institute holiday on the dates fixed 
Essential Qualification & Experience Candidates having MBBS, DPM/MD/DNB in Psychiatry. 
Experience: At least 3 years for MD/DNB. At least 5 years  
for DPM. 
 
Area of Specializations 
Part Time Contractual Psychological Counsellor 
Consolidated Pay Rs 2500/- per session for psychological counselling and Rs. 2500/-  
per session for any sensitization programme. 
Working hours To attend OPD for 03 Days per week  on fixed dates and time . (Each OPD 
session will be of 2 hours duration).  Change of dates will be allowed only if 
there is a Institute holiday on the dates fixed. 
Essential Qualification & Experience Candidates having Masters in Clinical Psychology/ Applied Psychology. 
Experience: 02 years’ relevant experience in counseling  
late adolescents and adults in an Academic Institution/ hospital setting or 
any other mental health clinic. Preference will be given to candidates having 
RCI registration 
Age: 65 years or below as on the cut off date 
 
 
 
General Terms and Conditions  
1.  Candidate has to ensure the authenticity of information provided in support of experience claimed,  other documents 
and photograph in the application. 
 2.  A self -attested copy of all the credentials should be enclosed  with the application  in proof of age, academic 
qualifications, category, experience, Awards & Honours, failing which no weightage shall be given in respect of the 
credentials claimed. 
3.  Any corrigendum/change/update shall be made available only on the Institute ’s website: www.isical.ac.in/jobs. The 
desirous candidates are advised to keep visiting the Institute’s website regularly for updates, if any. 
4.  Candidates are advised to bring all documents in original in support of their claim for verification  during the 
interview and a  set of self-attested copy  of the same for submission along with two (02) recent passport size 
photographs, failing which they will not be allowed to appear in the selection process. 
5.   The services of the selected candidate(s) shall be liable to be terminated by serving a notice of 30 days in writing 
by either side, unless otherwise agreed to by the Institute and the selected candidate(s). 
6.  The other terms and conditions of the service shall be such as may be specified by the appointing authority in the 
letter of appointment. 
Qualification/ Experience  
7.  Work Experience in Institutes of National Importance like IITs/IISERs/IISc/NITs and other similar Central Govt. 
Institutions is desirable. 
8.  The prescribed Essential Qualifications/Experience indicated are bare Minimum  and mere possession of the same 
will not entitle the candidate to be called for interview/test. Where number of applications received in response to an 
advertisement is large, it may not be convenient or possible for the Institute to call all the candidat es for interview. 
The Institute may restrict the number of candidates to be cal led for interview to a reasonable limit, on the basis of 
qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The candidates 
should, therefore, furnish details of all the higher qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over 
and above the minimum qualifications prescribed along with documentary evidences. 
Recruitment Methodology  
9.  In the event of number of applicati ons being large, the short -listing Committee of the Institute will adopt short - 
listing criteria to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview to a reasonable number by one or more 
of the following methods: 
a) On the basis of higher educational qualifications than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. 
b) On the basis of higher experience in the relevant field than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. 
10.  All the selections shall be made through the recommendations of the Selection Committee based on performance in 
interview which is intended to test various aspects of personality quotient, domain knowledge and suitability of the 
candidates for ready deployment for job / assignment with relevant experience etc. 
11.  The shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview before the Selection Committee on a given date and 
time, which will be conveyed through the Email ID provided by the applicants in their applications. Institute will not 
entertain any request  for chang e of date , time or venue of the interview by the individual can didates under any 
circumstances (No interview will be conducted through VC mode). 
12.  The Selection Committee will prepare a  merit list of the successful candidates based on performa nce in the 
interview. If required, the Selection Committee may also draw a waiting list with sufficient number of eligib le 
candidates.  
13.  The candidates should keep a regular watch on the ISI Website for the information related to the selection process.  
Reasons for Rejection of Applications  
14.  Applications shall be submitted in the prescribed format attached with this advertisement. Applications submitted in 
any other format will be summarily rejected. 
15.  Applications incomplete in any respect and not accompanied by self-attested copies of all relevant 
certificates/documents/photograph and signature will be summarily rejected. 
16.  Candidates must ensure before applying that they are eligible according to the criteria stipulated in the 
advertisement. If the candidates are found ineligible at any stage of the recruitment process or thereafter, he/she will 
be disqualified and his/her candidature/ appointment  will be cancelled. Hiding of information or submitting false 
information, if detected at any stage of the selection process, will lead to cancellation of candidature. 
 
Other terms and conditions:  
17. No interim enquiries/corresponde nce/communication of any sort will be entertained in the matter of the selection 
process. 
18.  The Institute reserves the right not to fill the vacancy/vacancies and no correspondence in this regard will be 
entertained. 
19.  Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence, political or otherwise, will be treated as a disqualification of 
the candidate. 
20.  The Institute reserves the right to withdraw any advertised post(s) at any time without giving any reason.  
 
21.  Any legal proceeding arising out of this advertisement shall have the jurisdiction of the Hon’ble Calcutta High Court 
only. 
22.  The cutoff date for determining the eligibility of the candidates in respect of the advertisement shall be the normal 
closing date for receipt of applications. 
23.  The competent authority reserves the right to extend the closing date for receipt of applications and also reserves the  
right to postpone/cancel the recruitment exercise for any/all the posts at any stage. 
24.  Candidates will be considered only for the posts they apply for. 
25.  Only matriculation/SSC certificate issued by the concerned education board will be considered as the proof of the 
date of birth. No other document will be accepted for verification of date of birth. 
26.  There is no application fee. 
27.  No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. 
28.       Fully complete application along with all requisite documents in a sealed cover should be sent by SPEED POST 
so as to reach to the Chief Executive  (A&F), Indian Statistical Institute , 203, B. T. Road, Kolkata – 700108 
within 30 days of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News. 
 
    Sd/- 
               Chief Executive (A&F)
